publicationDetails.detailsText: Center for Global AI Governance & Ethics Policy, 0[10.21428/a47b9270.0a016ce9]

detail.abstract:
The rapid institutionalization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance has increased the importance of independent scholarly evaluation of emerging global policy frameworks. "The International AI Safety Report 2026", produced by the Independent Expert Advisory Panel chaired by Yoshua Bengio and released under the United Kingdom Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT), has become a significant reference point for international discussions on AI safety, regulation, and risk governance. Despite its growing influence across governmental, multilateral, and regulatory environments, limited scholarly attention has been devoted to systematically assessing its methodological foundations, governance assumptions, and practical policy implications.

This paper presents a structured policy-audit and governance-analysis framework for evaluating the "International AI Safety Report 2026." Employing a qualitative interpretive methodology grounded in policy auditing, regulatory discourse analysis, publication-integrity assessment, and comparative governance evaluation, the study examines the report's conceptual coherence, evidentiary foundations, transparency, and institutional implications.

The analysis identifies three interrelated governance challenges. First, an evaluation gap persists between laboratory benchmark performance and real-world deployment reliability, raising questions regarding the predictive validity of current safety assessment approaches. Second, an agency paradox emerges whereby AI systems are simultaneously framed as potentially transformative societal risks while continuing to exhibit significant operational limitations and context-dependent fragility. Third, the report reflects elements of a democratic deficit associated with technocratic policy language, centralized expert dependency, and limited mechanisms for broad public engagement and AI literacy.

The study further argues that contemporary AI governance frameworks increasingly depend upon evaluative assumptions and institutional risk models whose pragmatic validation remains uneven across real-world deployment contexts. To explain these tensions, the paper introduces the concepts of technocratic enclosure, operational fragility, and epistemic dependency as analytical lenses for examining the relationship between expert-led governance and democratic legitimacy.

The paper concludes that while the "International AI Safety Report 2026" represents a landmark contribution to international scientific coordination on AI safety, its long-term regulatory effectiveness will depend upon the integration of transparent auditing mechanisms, dynamic environmental stress testing, inference-process accountability, and public-facing literacy infrastructures. By situating AI safety governance within broader debates concerning publication integrity, institutional legitimacy, and democratic accountability, this study contributes an interdisciplinary framework for evaluating emerging global AI governance architectures.

External DOI (PubPub): https://doi.org/10.21428/a47b9270.0a016ce9

AI.tldr: 本文对《国际AI安全报告2026》进行了系统性政策审计与治理分析，识别出评估差距、代理悖论和民主赤字三大治理挑战，并提出技术专家围栏、操作脆弱性和认知依赖性等概念，呼吁在AI治理中加强透明审计、动态压力测试、推理过程问责和公众素养建设。
AI.research_question: 《国际AI安全报告2026》在方法论基础、治理假设和实际政策影响方面存在哪些系统性缺陷？专家主导的AI安全治理如何平衡技术效能与民主合法性？
AI.motivation: 尽管该报告在政府、多边和监管环境中影响力日益增长，但学术界对其方法论基础、治理假设和政策含义缺乏系统的学术评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策审计、监管话语分析、出版完整性评估、比较治理评估；引入"技术专家围栏"（technocratic enclosure）、"操作脆弱性"（operational fragility）和"认知依赖性"（epistemic dependency）三个分析概念。
AI.method: 定性解释性方法，结合政策审计、监管话语分析、出版完整性评估和比较治理评估的多维分析框架。
AI.findings: 1) 评估差距：实验室基准性能与现实部署可靠性之间存在显著鸿沟；2) 代理悖论：AI同时被框架为潜在变革性社会风险与存在显著操作局限性的技术；3) 民主赤字：技术官僚政策语言、专家中心依赖和公众参与机制不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"技术专家围栏"、"操作脆弱性"和"认知依赖性"三个理论概念，用于分析专家主导治理与民主合法性之间的张力，将AI安全治理置于更广泛的出版完整性、制度合法性和民主问责辩论中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供透明审计机制、动态环境压力测试、推理过程问责和公众素养基础设施等具体建议；为评估新兴全球AI治理架构提供跨学科分析框架。

title: The Method on the Shelf: How Ceramic Tile Installation Exposed the Construction Industry's Economic Problem Too Big to See

detail.title: The Method on the Shelf: How Ceramic Tile Installation Exposed the Construction Industry's Economic Problem Too Big to See

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of TilingMyWay Inc., the company developing Method Intelligence, the system described in this paper. This research was conducted independently; no outside funding or third-party relationship influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not undergo formal institutional ethics review. The survey gathered market, cost, and method information from retail-industry personnel acting in their professional capacity. Individual participants' names were deliberately withheld to protect them; the business-level details recorded during the survey (retailer, location, date, and position title) are held as proprietary data and do not appear in this paper. No personal, health, or sensitive data about individuals was collected, and no vulnerable populations were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author through TilingMyWay Inc.

detail.abstract:
This paper documents a structural information asymmetry in the construction method supply chain and introduces an instrument to measure it. When a contractor selects an installation method, the cost distribution across specification-compliant assemblies — each producing the same warranted outcome — is invisible at the point of purchase. Drawing on Akerlof's theory of adverse selection and Graham's Mr. Market allegory, the paper reframes this as adverse selection of cost position rather than quality: every method is compliant, but the buyer cannot locate where in the distribution a given purchase falls. The result is a recurring, unrecorded overspend — quantified at $166.74 on a representative backer-board transaction, compounding to $120,051 over three years for a single contractor.

The central contribution is an adaptation of the Sharpe Ratio to method procurement: by treating cost savings as return and the dispersion of compliant method costs as risk, the instrument scores overspending risk before purchase rather than after. Across twelve compliant assemblies, scores range from 7.27 (compressed, low-risk) to −1.47 (collapsed); a single method's score is shown migrating from 1.69 to −0.21 as inflation moves through component costs. The analysis connects to recent evidence on declining U.S. construction-sector materials productivity, offering information asymmetry as a candidate market friction. The paper introduces Method Intelligence — a combinatorial specification ontology indexed by a method identification (MIS) code — as the information layer that renders the distribution legible.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了建筑施工方法供应链中的结构性信息不对称，并引入了一个事前衡量超支风险的指标。通过将夏普比率改造应用于方法采购（以成本节约为收益、合规方法成本离散度为风险），量化了代表性交易中166.74美元的超支，三年累计达12万美元。提出了"方法智能"（Method Intelligence）作为使成本分布可见的信息层解决方案。
AI.research_question: 建筑施工方法供应链中是否存在信息不对称导致的成本超支？如何事前衡量这种超支风险？
AI.motivation: 建筑施工行业存在多种合规的安装方法，它们产生相同的保证结果但成本分布不同。承包商在选购时无法看到这些成本分布，导致反复出现的、未被记录的超支现象。同时，美国建筑行业材料生产率持续下降，信息不对称可能是其中一个被忽视的市场摩擦。
AI.theoretical_framework: Akerlof的逆向选择理论（改编为"成本位置逆向选择"而非"质量逆向选择"）；Graham的Mr. Market寓言；夏普比率（经改造用于方法采购，以成本节约为收益、合规方法成本离散度为风险）。
AI.method: 对12种合规组装方法的成本分布进行量化分析；以代表性背板交易为案例计算超支金额；使用改造后的夏普比率对每种方法进行风险评分；追踪单一方法在通胀影响下评分从1.69迁移至-0.21的过程。
AI.findings: 单笔背板交易超支166.74美元，单个承包商三年累计超支120,051美元；12种合规组装方法评分范围从7.27（压缩型，低风险）到-1.47（坍塌型）；单一方法评分在通胀影响下从1.69降至-0.21。
AI.theory_contributions: 将逆向选择理论从"质量维度"拓展到"成本位置维度"——所有方法都合规，但买方无法知晓其购买落在成本分布的哪个位置；将夏普比率从金融领域改造应用于建筑施工方法采购场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"方法智能"（Method Intelligence）这一基于组合规格本体论的信息层，通过方法识别码（MIS code）使成本分布变得可读；提供了事前评估超支风险的量化工具，有助于承包商在购买前识别和避免高成本风险。

title: Perceived Architectural Fit and Legitimacy Judgments in Workplace AI Reliance: An Exploratory Vignette Study

detail.title: Perceived Architectural Fit and Legitimacy Judgments in Workplace AI Reliance: An Exploratory Vignette Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they are an independent researcher and have no known financial, personal, professional, or institutional relationships that could have influenced the design, conduct, analysis, interpretation, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted as minimal-risk human-participants online survey research and was IRB approved. The IRB review covered the study’s online vignette design, eligibility screening, informed-consent procedures, participant protections, and data-handling practices. The study followed standard ethical practices for minimal-risk online survey research, including informed consent, voluntary participation, de-identification of analytic data.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into workplace operations through generalpurpose systems, including large language models, enterprise copilots, foundation-model platforms, and AI assistants. The Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) explains adoption through performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, and facilitating conditions, but it gives less attention to whether reliance on an AI system is appropriate, defensible, open to review, and subject to governance in a specific work context. This exploratory vignette study examines perceived architectural fit, defined as the perceived alignment between an AI system's technical and governance supports and the accountability demands of its intended use context. This 2 × 2 vignette experiment surveyed U.S. workers with workplace AI exposure, collecting 350 unique responses and retaining 282 after screening. The manipulation checks supported the intended experimental distinctions; they shifted the planned check measures, and the high-fit condition significantly increased perceived architectural fit. However, assigned conditions did not significantly affect perceived legitimacy or AI reliance intention. In secondary same-source perception models, perceived architectural fit was associated with perceived legitimacy and added predictive value beyond the UTAUT baseline. Perceived architectural fit also showed a significant indirect association with AI reliance intention through perceived legitimacy. This pattern remained similar when the overlapping legitimacy item was excluded and when the reliance-intention items were modeled separately. The study provides construct-development evidence that perceived architectural fit is measurable, shows promise as a UTAUT extension for adoption perceptions, and offers organizations a practical lens for evaluating whether workplace AI systems appear reviewable, traceable, and governable for intended use.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过2×2情境实验，提出并验证了"感知架构契合度"这一新构念——即AI系统的技术与管理支撑与其使用场景的问责要求之间的匹配程度。研究发现，感知架构契合度能显著预测感知合法性，并通过感知合法性间接影响AI依赖意愿，且能为UTAUT模型提供增量解释力。
AI.research_question: 感知架构契合度（perceived architectural fit）——即AI系统的技术支持与治理支撑是否与其预期使用场景的问责要求相匹配——如何影响员工对工作场所AI系统的感知合法性和依赖意愿？
AI.motivation: 现有UTAUT模型对AI系统使用的解释侧重于绩效预期、努力预期等传统维度，但对AI系统在具体工作情境中是否"适当、可辩护、可审查、受治理"这一问责性问题关注不足。本研究旨在填补这一理论缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一技术接受与使用理论（UTAUT）；感知架构契合度（perceived architectural fit）——整合了AI系统的技术支持（可审查性、可追溯性）与治理支撑（可治理性）两个维度；感知合法性（perceived legitimacy）。
AI.method: 2×2情境实验（vignette experiment），操纵AI系统的高低技术支持与高低治理支撑，共收集350份美国有工作场所AI接触经验的员工问卷，经筛选保留282份有效样本。采用操纵检验、方差分析、回归分析及中介效应检验。
AI.findings: （1）操纵检验支持实验设计的区分有效性，高契合条件显著提高了感知架构契合度；（2）分配的实验条件对感知合法性与AI依赖意愿无显著直接效应；（3）在感知模型中，感知架构契合度显著预测感知合法性，且对UTAUT基线模型有增量解释力；（4）感知架构契合度通过感知合法性对AI依赖意愿有显著间接影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"感知架构契合度"这一新构念，将其作为UTAUT的扩展维度，弥补了现有技术接受理论对问责性（accountability）关注的不足。提供了构念效度的初步证据，表明该构念是可测量且有预测效力的。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织评估工作场所AI系统是否具备可审查性、可追溯性和可治理性提供了可操作的分析框架。帮助管理者理解：AI系统的技术设计与治理机制需要与使用场景的问责要求相匹配，才能被员工视为合法并愿意依赖。

title: The Influence of Aeta Traditional Healing Practices on Tourism Development in San Felipe, Zambales: A Phenomenological Study
affiliations: , Philippine Merchant Marine School, Inc., Philippine Merchant Marine School, Inc., Philippine Merchant Marine School, Inc., Philippine Merchant Marine School, Inc., Philippine Merchant Marine School, Inc. and Philippine Merchant Marine School, Inc.

detail.title: The Influence of Aeta Traditional Healing Practices on Tourism Development in San Felipe, Zambales: A Phenomenological Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study received ethical approval from the Institutional Review Board of the Philippine Merchant Marine School (Reference No: PMMS-IRB-2025-003). The research strictly adhered to ethical protocols for research involving indigenous peoples. The principle of Free, Prior, and Informed Consent (FPIC) was secured through dialogues with the Aeta community leadership and the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) Regional Office prior to data collection. Written informed consent was obtained from all participants, ensuring voluntary participation, anonymity, confidentiality, and the right to withdraw without consequence. All data were anonymized and stored securely.
declarations.funderStatement: funded by the researchers

detail.abstract: Cultural tourism worldwide places indigenous communities at an important paradox between creating economic advantages and challenging the commodification of intangible cultural heritage. This interplay was explored through the effect of Aeta traditional healing on tourism development in San Felipe, Zambales. There is limited scholarly knowledge about the subtle, human qualities of the actors involved. This phenomenological study was conducted to investigate the meaning of such lived experiences. Data were gathered through in-depth, semi-structured interviews with ten purposively selected key informants (Aeta healers, LGU leaders, tourists). Thematic analysis revealed that Aeta healing is not merely a practice but a profound spiritual calling and a cornerstone of cultural identity. However, its intersection with tourism is shaped by multifaceted dynamics, a broad spectrum of readiness among healers, a critical knowledge and policy gap within the LGU, and a community-wide ethical negotiation to prevent exploitation, embodied by the principle of kusang loob (voluntary giving). The study concludes that sustainable integration requires a co-created, empathetic framework that prioritizes cultural sovereignty and ensures the Aeta are the definitive agents of tourism development centered on their heritage.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了Aeta传统治疗与旅游发展之间的张力，发现其可持续整合需要以文化主权和自愿给予原则为基础的共创框架。
AI.research_question: Aeta传统治疗如何在旅游发展中发挥作用？其与旅游的互动面临哪些挑战与机遇？
AI.motivation: 学术界对文化遗产旅游中土著社区的微妙人性质素（如精神召唤、文化认同）了解有限，且存在经济发展与文化商品化之间的悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现象学（phenomenology）；文化商品化理论；文化主权理论；kusang loob（自愿给予）原则
AI.method: 现象学方法；深度半结构化访谈；主题分析；立意抽样（10位关键知情人：Aeta治疗师、地方政府领导、游客）
AI.findings: (1) Aeta治疗不仅是实践，更是精神召唤和文化认同基石；(2) 旅游互动呈现多重动态：治疗师准备程度不一、地方政府知识与政策缺口、社区伦理协商（防止剥削）；(3) kusang loob（自愿给予）是核心伦理原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了文化遗产旅游中"自愿给予"作为防止文化商品化剥削的伦理机制，拓展了文化主权理论在土著旅游中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土著社区旅游开发提供了以文化主权和共情共创为核心的可持续整合框架，强调Aeta应成为旅游发展的主导者。

title: Preservation of Multimodularity with Exchangeable Increments in Stochastic Operations
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology - H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial and Systems Engineering, , University of Macau - Faculty of Business Administration and

detail.title: Preservation of Multimodularity with Exchangeable Increments in Stochastic Operations
detail.abstract: Many decision-making problems involve multidimensional discrete choices, where performance measures are driven by partial-sum processes. In such settings, the decision maker's objective can often be expressed as the expected cost or profit associated with these multidimensional partial sums. This paper establishes preservation results for multimodularity in this class of processes. We identify sufficient conditions under which multimodularity is preserved, and provide counterexamples showing that these conditions cannot be relaxed without additional structure. In particular, if the post-realization function (prior to taking expectations) is multimodular, and the increments in each partial sum are nonnegative and infinitely exchangeable random variables, then the resulting performance metric (after taking expectations) remains multimodular. The result is both general and flexible: it accommodates dependence among uncertain increments and captures random shocks such as no-shows, cancellations, deterioration, clearance, and random yield. Building on this preservation result, we further establish multimodularity of the performance metric in several applications, including appointment scheduling in tandem queues, overbooking with product upgrading, perishable inventory systems with random lifetimes, and multisourcing systems with random yields.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了多维离散选择问题中，如果事后函数是多多模的且增量是非负无限可交换随机变量，则期望后的性能指标仍是多多模的，并应用于预约调度、超额预订、易逝品库存和多源采购等问题。
AI.research_question: 在多维离散选择问题中，偏和过程的性能指标的多多模性在什么条件下能够在取期望后得以保持？
AI.motivation: 许多决策问题涉及多维离散选择，其性能指标由偏和过程驱动，而多多模性在优化问题（如动态规划、边际分析）中具有重要价值，但现有研究对其在随机偏和过程中的保持条件缺乏系统性认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多维离散选择理论、偏和过程、多多模性理论、无限可交换随机变量理论。
AI.method: 理论证明：识别充分条件，构造反例证明条件不可放松，并通过多个应用场景（串联队列预约调度、产品升级超额预订、随机寿命易逝品库存、随机产出多源采购）验证结果的普适性。
AI.findings: (1) 当事后函数（取期望前）是多多模的，且每个偏和的增量是非负且无限可交换的随机变量时，取期望后的性能指标保持多多模性；(2) 该条件不可放松（有反例）；(3) 该结果适用于包含相依增量和多种随机冲击（如缺席、取消、变质、清仓、随机产出）的复杂场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了随机偏和过程中多多模性的保存定理，扩展了多多模性理论在随机优化中的适用范围，为非独立随机增量情境下的结构性质研究提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预约调度、超额预订、易逝品库存管理和多源采购等实际运营管理问题提供了优化便利，使这些问题的目标函数可以保持结构性质，从而简化动态规划求解和边际分析。

title: Middle-Power Industrial Policymaking for Resilience: An Assessment of South Korea's Legislative Apparatus for Securing Critical Minerals & Implications for U.S.-ROK Cooperation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Middle-Power Industrial Policymaking for Resilience: An Assessment of South Korea's Legislative Apparatus for Securing Critical Minerals & Implications for U.S.-ROK Cooperation

declarations.funderStatement: Funding Source Disclosure: The author, Donna E. Chung, gratefully acknowledges financial support for this research project and paper by the U.S. Fulbright Scholar Program, which is sponsored by the U.S. Department of State and the Korean-American Educational Commission (KAEC). detail.abstract: Critical minerals constitute a strategic terrain for South Korea. They are essential upstream inputs for batteries, semiconductors, defense electronics, and other advanced manufacturing core to Korea's economic security. Amidst intensifying U.S.-China competition and China's global dominance over these inputs, the Korean government has constructed an elaborate legislative and policy apparatus to reduce Korea's vulnerability. Using Dani Rodrik's 'ten design principles' for new industrial policy, this paper evaluates this apparatus, arguing that while South Korea has built a substantial middle-power critical minerals policy architecture, the system contains weaknesses that, if unaddressed, raise important questions about its efficacy. The apparatus scores relatively well in identifying vulnerabilities, creating formal authorities, and putting in place a dense set of tools. It is weak, however, in disciplining industrial policy and fostering learning. The article further argues that Korea's policy apparatus is designed for administrative 1 flexibility and discretion. Domestic politics matter in this context as the same policy machinery could support deeper U.S.-aligned trusted-supply-chain integration or a slow-moving diversification effort of 'maximum flexibility' between the U.S. and China. The article concludes with a preliminary assessment of the U.S.-ROK critical minerals cooperation and policy recommendations for a stronger allied partnership.

AI.tldr: 本文运用 Dani Rodrik 的产业政策十项设计原则，系统评估了韩国的关键矿产政策架构，指出其虽在识别脆弱性、建立正式机构和工具集方面表现良好，但在产业政策纪律与学习机制方面存在薄弱环节，且政策设计偏向行政灵活性与自由裁量权，可能在中美之间采取"最大灵活性"策略。
AI.research_question: 韩国的关键矿产政策架构是否有效？其优势与缺陷分别是什么？
AI.motivation: 关键矿产是韩国电池、半导体、国防电子等先进制造业的核心上游投入品，在中美竞争加剧且中国主导这些资源的背景下，韩国构建了庞大的立法与政策体系以减少脆弱性，有必要对其有效性进行系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: Dani Rodrik 的"新产业政策十项设计原则"
AI.method: 基于 Rodrik 十项原则的政策架构评估框架，对韩国关键矿产立法与政策进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 韩国政策架构在识别脆弱性、建立正式权威和部署丰富政策工具方面得分较高，但在产业政策纪律（discipline）和促进学习（learning）方面薄弱；政策设计偏向行政灵活性与自由裁量权，国内政治影响其走向：可能支持深度对美联盟的信任供应链整合，也可能采取在中美之间的"最大灵活性"缓慢多元化策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将 Rodrik 的产业政策原则应用于关键矿产领域，拓展了该理论框架在资源安全与地缘政治情境下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国关键矿产政策的改进提供具体方向（加强产业政策纪律与学习机制），并为美韩关键矿产合作及联盟伙伴关系提供政策建议。

title: Measurement as Convention: Why Measurement Choices Are Prior Theoretical Commitments, Not Neutral Observations

detail.title: Measurement as Convention: Why Measurement Choices Are Prior Theoretical Commitments, Not Neutral Observations

publicationDetails.detailsText:
Series: Audited State Research Series, Working Paper 1 of 6
Companion publication: The Wealth of Understanding (Arne Mayoh, forthcoming)
Related papers in series: SSRN links to Papers 2–6 (add upon upload)

detail.abstract: Measurement is not a neutral act. The choice of what to measure, how to measure it, and what counts as a valid unit is a prior theoretical commitmentone that shapes what becomes visible, what becomes invisible, and ultimately what becomes actionable. This paper argues that measurement conventions are not descriptions of reality but agreements about which aspects of reality are worth attending to. When those conventions are misaligned with the phenomena they are meant to illuminate, they do not merely produce inaccurate data-they render entire categories of value structurally invisible. This has consequences not only for what we know, but for what we are capable of knowing.

AI.tldr: 本文论述测量并非中立行为，测量惯例是对现实的规范性承诺，而非客观描述。当测量方式与现象不匹配时，会使某些价值类别在结构上被隐匿，影响我们认知和实践的边界。
AI.research_question: 测量惯例如何塑造认知可见性和行动可能性？当测量方式与所测现象错位时，会产生何种结构性后果？
AI.motivation: 质疑测量的中立性假设，揭示测量选择背后隐秘的理论承诺及其对知识生产的深刻影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 测量认识论、社会建构主义、知识生产与权力批判
AI.method: 理论论证与概念分析
AI.findings: 测量惯例是"关于什么值得关注的协议"；错位的测量不仅产生不准确数据，更使某些价值类别在结构上不可见；测量决定"我们能知道什么"的上限。
AI.theory_contributions: 将测量从技术问题提升为认识论问题，提出"结构性隐匿"概念，拓展了对知识边界的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示管理者、政策制定者和研究者在设计指标体系时需反思测量预设，否则可能在无意中系统性地遮蔽重要价值维度。

title: Volatility Forecasting and Return Prediction under Market Regimes: Evidence from High-Frequency Chinese Equity Data
affiliations: and University of Warsaw - Faculty of Economic Sciences

detail.title: Volatility Forecasting and Return Prediction under Market Regimes: Evidence from High-Frequency Chinese Equity Data
detail.abstract: This study investigates whether regime-dependent volatility forecasting and machine-learning-based return prediction can be jointly integrated to improve both statistical forecasting performance and economic strategy outcomes in equity markets. Using high-frequency CSI 300 Index data from 2005 to 2023, a sequential twostage framework is developed. In the first stage, realized volatility is modeled using regime-augmented HARQ specifications combined with Markov-switching GJR-GARCH filtering to capture long-memory dynamics, asymmetry, and structural market regimes. In the second stage, volatility forecasts, regime indicators, and return-related predictors are incorporated into an XGBoost return-prediction model estimated through a strictly walk-forward out-of-sample procedure. The empirical results demonstrate that regime-aware volatility forecasting consistently outperforms baseline HARQ models across forecast evaluation metrics and is generally supported by formal forecast comparison tests. In contrast, return predictability remains weak, state-dependent, and concentrated primarily in low-volatility regimes. Although naive predictive trading strategies generally fail after accounting for realistic transaction costs, carefully designed implementations incorporating volatility scaling, low-volatility gating, threshold calibration, and turnover controls can improve defensive economic performance. The findings suggest that the practical value of predictive systems in financial markets may depend less on generating strong unconditional return forecasts and more on transforming weak state-dependent signals into economically robust portfolio allocation rules. Overall, the study contributes by integrating econometric volatility modeling, regime classification, machine-learning return prediction, and implementation realism within a unified framework.

AI.tldr: 本文利用沪深300指数2005-2023年的高频数据，构建了一个两阶段框架，将区制依赖的波动率预测与机器学习收益预测相结合。结果表明区制感知的波动率预测优于传统模型，但收益可预测性较弱且仅存在于低波动区制。研究贡献在于将计量波动率建模、区制分类、机器学习收益预测与实施现实性纳入统一框架。
AI.research_question: 区制依赖的波动率预测与基于机器学习的收益预测能否联合整合，以同时提升统计预测绩效和经济策略效果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将波动率预测和收益预测分开处理，缺乏对两者联合整合的系统性探索，且多数研究忽略了实际交易成本等实施现实性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区制增强的HARQ波动率模型、马尔可夫区制转换GJR-GARCH滤波、XGBoost机器学习收益预测模型
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段使用区制增强HARQ模型结合马尔可夫区制转换GJR-GARCH进行波动率建模；第二阶段将波动率预测、区制指标和收益相关预测因子纳入XGBoost模型，采用严格的前向滚动样本外预测流程。
AI.findings: （1）区制感知的波动率预测持续优于基准HARQ模型；（2）收益可预测性较弱、呈现状态依赖性，主要集中在低波动区制；（3）简单预测性交易策略在考虑真实交易成本后失败，但结合波动率缩放、低波动率门控、阈值校准和换手率控制的精心设计能改善防御性经济表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将计量经济学波动率建模、区制分类、机器学习收益预测整合在一个统一框架内，揭示了预测系统在金融市场中的实际价值可能更依赖于将弱状态依赖信号转化为稳健的资产配置规则，而非产生强的无条件收益预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际交易策略设计提供了具体指导：波动率缩放、低波动率门控、阈值校准和换手率控制等机制可以提升策略的防御性经济表现；提醒实践者注意交易成本对预测性策略盈利能力的侵蚀效应。

title: Reframing TPO as an Estimator of Moments and Entropy of Equity Markets

detail.title: Reframing TPO as an Estimator of Moments and Entropy of Equity Markets
detail.abstract:
This paper provides the first formal empirical treatment of Market Profile concepts in the SPX cash equity market by treating the weekly Time Price Opportunity (TPO) profile as a moment and entropy estimator of the realized price acceptance distribution. Working with 65-minute SPX bars spanning January 2015 to June 2026 (489 weekly profiles), each distribution is characterised using six shape metrics: skewness, excess kurtosis, Shannon entropy, the Hartigan dip statistic, Value Area Width, and tail occupancy. Four distributional regimes are defined using trailing 52-week rolling percentile thresholds specified prior to any empirical analysis: BALANCED, DIRECTIONAL, TRANSITIONAL, and EXTREME.

Four hypotheses are tested. H1 establishes that weekly SPX TPO distributions are persistently non-Gaussian: 48 of 50 randomly sampled profiles reject normality at p < 0.05. H2 confirms that each regime produces a statistically distinct distributional fingerprint: EXTREME weeks exhibit narrow Value Area Width (mean 0.36, p = 5e-50); TRANSITIONAL weeks show the highest dip statistic (p = 2e-26), confirming genuine bimodality. H3 shows that TRANSITIONAL weeks predict next-week range contraction (0.76x expansion ratio, p = 0.0001), a finding that survives volatility conditioning. H4 yields two null results (POC drift streak; Naked POC magnetism) and one structural finding: when price approaches the prior week's POC from higher ground, the level acts as a reliable floor (67.6% hold rate, p < 0.001); when approached from lower ground, it does not act as a reliable ceiling (42.7%, p = 0.43). Weeks in which the POC fails as support predict higher 13-week forward returns (+5.8% vs +2.1%, p = 0.002), consistent with a capitulation and recovery mechanism. Value area analysis further shows that reaching the POC after penetrating the Value Area High collapses the probability of reclaiming that boundary from 95% to 43%.

All principal findings are validated in six additional instruments (SPY, DIA, IWM, QQQ, XLF, XLK). Five of seven instruments confirm H3, and six of seven confirm the FROM_ABOVE directional asymmetry, establishing both as broadly universal structural properties. The divergence in H1 non-Gaussianity rates between SPX (98%) and ETF replicants (68-76%) is attributed to authorized participant arbitrage smoothing intraday price acceptance. Several widely-held practitioner beliefs, including POC magnet effects and the symmetric support-resistance role of value area boundaries, are empirically rejected or substantially qualified.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对SPX现金股票市场的市场轮廓概念进行正式实证分析，将每周TPO分布视为价格接受分布的矩与熵估计量，定义了四种分布制度，测试了四个假设，发现了显著的制度特征、预测能力及方向性不对称性，并跨7个工具验证了主要发现。
AI.research_question: SPX现金股票市场中每周TPO分布的特征是什么？不同分布制度是否具有统计上可区分的特征？TPO分布特征是否具有预测能力？关键市场微观结构信念（如POC磁效应、价值区边界对称支撑/阻力）是否成立？
AI.motivation: 市场轮廓（Market Profile）概念在 practitioners 中广泛使用，但缺乏形式化的实证处理。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过严格的统计检验评估市场轮廓框架的有效性，并检验多个从业者信念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场轮廓理论、价格接受分布、熵估计、制度转换、支撑/阻力微观结构、非高斯分布。
AI.method: 使用2015年1月至2026年6月间489个周度TPO分布，提取6个形状指标（偏度、超额峰度、香农熵、Hartigan dip统计量、价值区宽度、尾部占用）。基于52周滚动百分位数阈值定义四种制度，进行假设检验，并跨7个工具进行验证。
AI.findings: (1) 周度SPX TPO分布持续性非高斯（48/50拒绝正态性）；(2) 四种制度具有统计上不同的分布指纹：EXTREME周价值区宽度窄，TRANSITIONAL周呈现真实双峰性；(3) TRANSITIONAL周预测下周区间收缩（0.76倍扩张比）；(4) POC方向性不对称：从上方接近时POC是可靠地板（67.6%），从下方接近时不是可靠天花板（42.7%）；(5) POC作为支撑失败预示更高远期收益；(6) 穿透VAH后触及POC使重新收回VAH概率从95%降至43%。跨工具验证支持H3和FROM_ABOVE方向性不对称的普遍性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对市场轮廓概念进行形式化实证处理；定义了统计上可区分的TPO分布制度；发现了POC方向性不对称（从上方接近与从下方接近的非对称支撑/阻力效应）；揭示了从上方接近POC作为可靠地板但下方不作为可靠天花板的结构性发现；解释了SPX与ETF之间非高斯率差异的套利平滑机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易者提供了基于TPO分布制度的量化交易框架；推翻了POC磁效应和价格接受边界对称支撑/阻力的从业者信念；提供了基于POC失败作为支撑的展望信号（预测未来13周收益差异显著）；揭示了价值区边界被穿刺后的概率变化（VAH被突破后触及POC使回收概率崩塌）。

title: The African Geopolitical Risk Index: A Daily, Country-Level Measure for Fifty-Four Countries, 1979-2026
affiliations: International University of Casablanca, Business School

detail.title: The African Geopolitical Risk Index: A Daily, Country-Level Measure for Fifty-Four Countries, 1979-2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: This research has received no funding

detail.abstract: I introduce the African Geopolitical Risk Index, the first daily, country-level measure of geopolitical risk built specifically for the African continent. The index covers all fifty-four African countries from 1979 to 2026, and is constructed from the global news-event record rather than from a small panel of Western newspapers. For each country and each day I measure the share of that country's news-event coverage that reports conflict or threat, separating the verbal expression of hostility, which I label threats, from its material realization, which I label acts. The measure is article-weighted, so that episodes commanding wide coverage carry more weight than those mentioned in passing, and it is expressed as a share of total coverage, so that it captures the intensity of conflict in the news rather than the overall volume of news. I normalize each series to a common reference window so that levels are comparable over time and across countries, and I produce the index at four levels of aggregation: a continent-wide headline, a separate series for every country, five regional aggregates, and a threats-versus-acts decomposition. I describe two complementary constructions: a long-history, event-based index drawn from the GDELT Event Database and coded through the CAMEO conflict taxonomy, and a modern, fully multilingual, theme-based index drawn from the GDELT Global Knowledge Graph. This paper documents the data, the screening methodology, the aggregation and normalization, and the full keyword and code lists in the appendix, so that the index is transparent and reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个专门针对非洲大陆的日度、国家层面地缘政治风险指数（African Geopolitical Risk Index），覆盖54个非洲国家（1979-2026年），基于全球新闻事件记录而非西方报纸小样本，分为威胁（言语敌意）与行动（物质实现）两类，并提供大陆、国家、区域及威胁-行动分解等多层级聚合。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个覆盖全部非洲国家的、日度的、可比较的、透明的地缘政治风险指数？
AI.motivation: 现有地缘政治风险指数（如GPR）多聚焦发达国家或全球总体，缺乏专门针对非洲大陆、覆盖所有国家、具有日度频率且方法透明的系统性测量工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险测量；冲突的言语表达（威胁）与物质实现（行动）的区分；新闻事件覆盖强度与份额的加权方法。
AI.method: 基于GDELT事件数据库（CAMEO冲突分类编码）和GDELT全球知识图谱（多语言主题索引）构建，采用文章加权（广泛报道的事件权重更高）、份额标准化（以冲突新闻占总新闻的比例测度强度）、统一参考窗口归一化，实现跨时间与跨国家可比。
AI.findings: 成功构建了覆盖54个非洲国家的日度地缘政治风险指数，提供大陆级、国家级、区域级及威胁-行动分解四层聚合结果；两种互补构建路径（事件基与主题基）增强了指数的稳健性和覆盖范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非洲地缘政治风险的量化研究提供了首个系统性的日度面板数据工具；将威胁（言语）与行动（物质）的概念区分操作化为可测量的指数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者、人道主义组织等提供实时监测非洲各国地缘政治风险的工具；方法透明可复现，便于后续研究更新与扩展。

title: The Arabic AI-GPR Index: Measuring Geopolitical Risk from Arabic-Language News
affiliations: International University of Casablanca, Business School

detail.title: The Arabic AI-GPR Index: Measuring Geopolitical Risk from Arabic-Language News
detail.abstract: I construct the first daily index of geopolitical risk built entirely from Arabic-language news. Existing measures read global tension through English-language, predominantly Western, newspapers, an Anglocentric vantage point that is least reliable precisely where geopolitical risk is most concentrated, the Middle East and North Africa. Using a curated corpus of leading pan-Arab outlets accessed through GDELT, I measure risk along two independent tracks: a transparent theme-based screen and a large-language-model reading of each article in the manner of Iacoviello and Tong (2026). The two tracks agree almost perfectly, and I argue that this convergence makes the transparent, reproducible, and costless theme-based measure the preferable one: it delivers an equally responsive signal without the opacity, instability, and expense of article-level inference. The resulting index spans 2015 to 2026, rises at every major regional episode, and co-moves with the original Geopolitical Risk index of Caldara and Iacoviello (2022) and with the AI-GPR (a monthly change correlation of about 0.6 with both), while diverging in levels in economically meaningful ways. Its oil component tracks the Middle East oil risk index of Iacoviello at a correlation of 0.82. I decompose the index by country, country pair, actor, event type, sub-national hotspot, threats versus acts, and oil corridor, and I release the whole series as an open, monthly-updated resource.

AI.tldr: 本文利用阿拉伯语新闻构建了首个每日地缘政治风险指数（GPR-A），覆盖2015-2026年，并通过主题筛选与大语言模型双重验证，证实低成本、透明的主题法同样有效。该指数与原有英语指数高度相关，但在水平和区域细节上提供增量信息，并分解至国家、事件类型、石油通道等维度。
AI.research_question: 如何利用阿拉伯语新闻构建一个可靠、透明、可复现的地缘政治风险指数，以弥补现有英语主导指数在中东北非地区的测量偏差？
AI.motivation: 现有地缘政治风险指数（如Caldara & Iacoviello的GPR）主要依赖英语媒体（西方视角），而地缘政治风险最集中的中东北非地区恰恰是英语媒体覆盖最薄弱之处。这种"盎格鲁中心"视角可能导致系统性测量偏差，需要构建本土语言的风险指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险测量方法论、新闻文本分析（主题筛选 vs. 大语言模型）、指数构建与验证框架。
AI.method: (1) 利用GDELT平台获取泛阿拉伯主流媒体语料库；(2) 设计两条独立测量路径：透明主题筛选法 和 大语言模型逐篇文章推断法（仿Iacoviello & Tong 2026）；(3) 两条路径交叉验证；(4) 与已有GPR指数和AI-GPR指数进行相关性对比；(5) 多维度分解（国家、国家对、行为体、事件类型、次国家热点、威胁vs行动、石油通道）。
AI.findings: (1) 两条测量路径几乎完美一致，支持采用低成本的主题法；(2) 指数在2015-2026年间每次重大区域事件均显著上升；(3) 与原GPR和AI-GPR的月度变化相关性约为0.6；(4) 石油子成分与中东石油风险指数相关性达0.82；(5) 指数在水平值上存在经济上有意义的差异，反映阿拉伯语视角的增量信息。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次从非英语（阿拉伯语）视角构建地缘政治风险指数，挑战了现有文献中"英语媒体=全球风险"的隐含假设；(2) 证明了主题筛选法与大语言模型法在风险测量上的等价性，为低成本指数构建提供了方法论依据；(3) 揭示了语言/视角差异如何影响风险指数的水平值，丰富了地缘政治风险测量的方法论辩论。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 公开提供首个阿拉伯语每日地缘政治风险指数（2015-2026），按月更新，作为开源资源；(2) 为投资者、政策制定者和研究人员提供了更精准的中东北非风险敞口度量；(3) 多维度分解（石油通道、国家对、威胁vs行动等）可直接用于资产定价、供应链风险管理、军事冲突预警等实务场景；(4) 证明了低成本主题法的高效性，降低了后续研究者的数据门槛。

title: Ontology Poisoning in Military AI Fusion Systems: Attack Vectors Against Palantir-Class Architectures
affiliations: VTU University

detail.title: Ontology Poisoning in Military AI Fusion Systems: Attack Vectors Against Palantir-Class Architectures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or organizational affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants, patient data, personal data, or animal subjects were involved in this research. Ethics committee approval was therefore not required. The study is based exclusively on publicly available information, threat modeling, and security analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Palantir Technologies' Maven Smart System (MSS), designated a U.S. Department of Defense Program of Record in 2026 and deployed across NATO's Allied Command Operations, is among the most operationally significant AI fusion platforms in contemporary warfare. Its ontology-based data model integrates over 179 heterogeneous intelligence sources; an embedded large language model (LLM) hub powered by Anthropic's Claude on classified networks compresses sensor-to-shooter decision cycles from hours to minutes. This paper characterises three underanalysed adversarial attack vectors specific to MSS-class architectures. AV-1: Ontology Poisoning-the primary contribution-corrupts the semantic object layer to forge entity relationships, reclassify hostile objects as friendly, and inject phantom units; its coupling to downstream LLM reasoning creates a dual-substrate propagation effect with no direct analogue in existing knowledge-graph poisoning literature. AV-2: LLM Prompt Injection exploits the absence of a cryptographic boundary between trusted ontology context and externally sourced intelligence documents retrieved via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to manipulate AI-generated courses of action. AV-3: Multi-Source Sensor Feed Spoofing exploits MSS's corroboration-based confidence logic to amplify-rather than merely introduce-false classifications across the ingestion pipeline. Each vector is analysed via counterfactual scenarios grounded in the documented deployment contexts of the 2026 Iran conflict, the NATO ACO deployment, and the February 2026 Maduro operation. A three-layer defence framework (D-1 through D-3) incorporating PKI-based object signing, Merkle-tree ontology versioning, and zero-knowledge provenance attestation is proposed, together with a forensic audit extension linking manipulation events to IHL operator accountability. A structured security-property coverage evaluation demonstrates the framework's design coverage properties and identifies residual gaps. Five open research problems are identified.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Palantir Maven Smart System（MSS）这一军事AI融合平台面临的三种新型对抗性攻击向量——本体投毒（核心贡献）、LLM提示注入和多源传感器馈送欺骗，并提出了三层防御框架（D-1至D-3）及法证审计扩展方案。
AI.research_question: MSS类架构面临哪些尚未被充分分析的对抗性攻击向量？如何设计防御框架来应对这些威胁？
AI.motivation: MSS作为美国国防部记录在案的项目和北约盟军作战司令部部署的关键AI融合平台，其军事决策安全性至关重要，但现有文献缺乏对其特有架构攻击向量的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于本体数据模型、大语言模型（LLM）集成的AI融合架构；对抗性攻击理论；知识图谱投毒理论；检索增强生成（RAG）安全；传感器融合置信度逻辑。
AI.method: 通过反事实场景分析（基于2026年伊朗冲突、北约ACO部署、2026年2月马杜罗行动三个真实部署背景）对三种攻击向量进行技术分析和防御框架设计，并通过安全属性覆盖评估验证防御框架效果。
AI.findings: (1) 本体投毒（AV-1）可伪造实体关系、将敌目标重分类为友方、注入幻影单位，且与下游LLM推理耦合形成"双基板传播效应"；(2) LLM提示注入（AV-2）利用可信本体上下文与外部RAG文档间缺乏密码学边界来操纵AI生成的行动方案；(3) 多源传感器欺骗（AV-3）利用MSS的验证置信度逻辑放大而非仅引入错误分类；(4) 提出的三层防御框架在结构化安全属性覆盖评估中显示设计覆盖特性，但存在剩余缺口；(5) 确定了五个开放研究问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画了MSS类军事AI融合平台的三种特有攻击向量，特别是"本体投毒"概念及其与LLM推理的"双基板传播效应"——这一效应在现有知识图谱投毒文献中没有直接类比。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了包含PKI对象签名、Merkle树本体版本控制和零知识来源验证的三层防御框架，以及将操纵事件与国际人道法（IHL）操作者责任挂钩的法证审计扩展方案。

title: Blockchain-Enabled Cold Chain Traceability for Returnable Plastic Crate Packaging: A Multi-Stage Smart Contract Framework from Farm Harvest to Retail Shelf

detail.title: Blockchain-Enabled Cold Chain Traceability for Returnable Plastic Crate Packaging: A Multi-Stage Smart Contract Framework from Farm Harvest to Retail Shelf

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Originality and Prior Publication The authors declare that this manuscript is original and has not been previously published, submitted, or accepted for publication in any peer-reviewed journal or conference proceeding. The work presented herein has been deposited as a preprint on SSRN solely to facilitate early dissemination and scholarly feedback. Author Contributions The authors confirm that all individuals listed as authors have made substantive intellectual contributions to the conception, design, execution, or interpretation of the work reported. All authors have reviewed and approved the final manuscript and agree to be accountable for all aspects of the work. Conflicts of Interest The authors declare no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced the design, conduct, reporting, or interpretation of the research presented in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract:
Cold chain failures and inadequate traceability together account for approximately 14% of annual fresh produce losses worldwide. Returnable plastic crates (RPCs), the dominant fieldharvest container in produce distribution, present a distinctive tracking challenge: a single crate undergoes hundreds of operational trips, transfers across several independent organisations, and is routinely unpacked and repacked into individual retail units, yet it has historically lacked a persistent digital identity linking the physical asset to its full handling record.
This study presents and evaluates a blockchain-based traceability architecture engineered for RPC-centric produce supply chains operating under a continuous 11°C cold chain requirement. The system integrates GS1-standard QR identification, a Hyperledger Fabric 2.5 permissioned ledger, Controlant IoT temperature data loggers, Zebra Technologies scanning and label-printing hardware, and purpose-built smart contract logic to generate a tamper-resistant, multi-party provenance record spanning four custody stages.
A session-based parent-child blockchain linkage protocol was developed to address the provenance continuity problem created when bulk crate contents are disaggregated into multiple retail units. Unlike conventional blockchain food traceability implementations that log custody events without reference to verified compliance states, the proposed framework embeds temperature compliance assessment as a mandatory precondition for smart contract execution: a custody transfer cannot proceed unless real-time Controlant logger data confirms that cold chain requirements have been met.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一个基于区块链的可追溯架构，专为采用可回收塑料周转筐（RPC）的农产品供应链设计，解决了冷链断链与追溯断层问题。该架构通过Hyperledger Fabric 2.5、GS1标准QR码、IoT温度记录仪和智能合约，实现了温度合规性作为交接前置条件的多方可信追溯。
AI.research_question: 如何为以可回收塑料周转筐（RPC）为核心的生鲜农产品供应链构建一个融合区块链、IoT与智能合约的可追溯架构，以同时解决冷链合规验证与多批次拆分场景下的追溯连续性问题？
AI.motivation: 冷链失效和追溯不足每年导致全球约14%的生鲜农产品损耗；RPC虽为田间主要采收容器，但缺乏持久数字身份，且面临跨组织流转与拆零包装的追溯断裂挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区块链分布式账本、GS1标准标识体系、基于会话的父子区块链链接协议、温度合规嵌入智能合约的前置条件机制。
AI.method: 基于Hyperledger Fabric 2.5构建许可链，集成Controlant IoT温度记录仪、Zebra扫描打印硬件与GS1 QR码，设计会话式父子区块链接口协议，并通过四个保管阶段的实验评估系统性能。
AI.findings: 系统实现了温度合规性作为保管交接的前置条件；通过会话式父子链接协议解决了散装RPC内容物拆分为多个零售单元时的追溯连续性问题；相较于仅记录保管事件的传统区块链追溯方案，本框架将温度合规评估嵌入智能合约执行逻辑中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了会话式父子区块链链接协议，解决了农产品供应链中散装容器拆零场景下的追溯连续性理论难题；将温度合规评估从离线检验提升为智能合约执行的前置条件，丰富了区块链食品追溯的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为RPC主导的生鲜供应链提供了可直接部署的区块链追溯技术方案；通过将冷链合规嵌入数字交接流程，有助于降低生鲜损耗、提升食品安全与可审计性；为GS1标准、IoT硬件与区块链的集成提供了工程化参考。

title: Constitutional Intelligence: A Unified, Formally Verified Architecture for Regulated Industrial Autonomy
affiliations: Universal Standard Axiom Corp

detail.title: Constitutional Intelligence: A Unified, Formally Verified Architecture for Regulated Industrial Autonomy
detail.abstract: The constitutional economy comprises thirty industry kernels — pharmaceutical, aerospace, finance, energy, healthcare, defense, and twenty-four others — each operating under its own instantiation of the Russell Unified Axiomatic Stack (RUAX). These kernels must communicate. A pharmaceutical robot must transmit patient data to a hospital database; an autonomous vehicle must report its trajectory to an energy grid controller; a drone must receive weather data from a meteorological kernel. Cross-kernel communication introduces a critical risk: translation loss, semantic drift, and corruption of constitutional constraints. This paper presents the Cross-Kernel Interoperability Handshake: a pure constitutional mathematics protocol, expressed in WAD arithmetic (1018-precision integer arithmetic, standardized in DeFi and now generalized to constitutional systems), that requires both sender and receiver to cryptographically prove they operate under identical constitutional axioms before any data is exchanged. The handshake proceeds in three phases: (1) Axiom Declaration via SHA3-256 (NIST FIPS 202) constitutional hash comparison; (2) Fixed-Point Verification grounded in the Banach Contraction Mapping Theorem; and (3) WAD-Arithmetic Challenge-Response using the R3 refinement operator. Once completed, both kernels share a verified constitutional context. Data exchange proceeds without translation — because the axioms are provably identical. No trust is required. No central authority is needed. The entire handshake completes in under 1 microsecond on ANRI-PHOTON hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨核心互操作握手协议，通过纯宪法数学协议（基于WAD算术、SHA3-256哈希和巴拿赫压缩映射定理）实现不同行业核心之间的安全通信，无需信任或中央权威，即可在1微秒内完成。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖信任或中央权威的情况下，确保不同宪法经济核心之间安全、语义无损地交换数据？
AI.motivation: 不同行业核心（制药、航天、金融、能源等）之间必须通信，但跨核心通信面临翻译损失、语义漂移和宪法约束被破坏的关键风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: Russell统一公理栈（RUAX）、巴拿赫压缩映射定理、WAD算术（10^18精度整数算术）、SHA3-256哈希、R3精炼算子。
AI.method: 三阶段协议：(1) 基于SHA3-256宪法哈希比较的公理声明；(2) 基于巴拿赫压缩映射定理的定点验证；(3) 使用R3精炼算子的WAD算术挑战-响应。
AI.findings: 该握手协议可在ANRI-PHOTON硬件上于1微秒内完成，无需信任或中央权威，确保只有操作于相同宪法公理的内核之间才能进行数据交换。
AI.theory_contributions: 将DeFi中的WAD算术泛化到宪法系统，将巴拿赫压缩映射定理应用于跨核心通信验证，提出基于公理一致性而非翻译的通信范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需信任、无需中央权威的跨行业核心安全通信方案，在亚微秒级别完成，适用于制药、自动驾驶、无人机等场景。

title: How to deal with machine learning bias in economic history
affiliations: University of Southern Denmark, University of Southern Denmark and University of Southern Denmark

detail.title: How to deal with machine learning bias in economic history
detail.abstract: Machine learning (ML) has rapidly transformed economic history, lowering costs of digitization, data linkage, and imputation, and making information in historical text usable at scale. This paper offers a practical guide to using these tools well. However, ML tools have also created new problems. Prediction errors are often systematically correlated with covariates of interest, so even highly accurate models can distort and sometimes reverse coefficients, and standard validation cannot detect this. Given that ML tools often perform worse for historical data, this problem is especially severe for the field of economic history. We also identify a solution to this problem. We show that recent debiasing methods can correct such bias for a wide class of applications, using a small, randomly sampled set of expert-coded labels while retaining the efficiency of large-scale prediction. We organize the field with a taxonomy of three ML tasks, survey the literature along it, and indicate where debiasing applies and where validation against proxies remains the only recourse. We close with best-practice guidance on digitization, model choice, and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了机器学习在经济学史中的应用，指出ML工具虽降低了数字化、数据链接和插补成本，但预测误差与协变量系统相关会导致系数偏差，标准验证无法检测。作者提出利用少量专家编码标签的去偏方法可纠正此偏差，并构建了三类ML任务分类法，提供最佳实践指南。
AI.research_question: 机器学习工具在经济学史应用中产生的系统性预测偏差如何识别与纠正？
AI.motivation: ML工具在经济学史中广泛应用，但预测误差与协变量系统相关可能导致系数扭曲甚至反转，且标准验证无法检测，这一问题在历史数据中尤为严重，亟需解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习预测偏差理论、去偏方法（debiasing methods）、分类法（三类ML任务）
AI.method: 文献综述与分类法构建，结合去偏方法的理论论证与适用性分析
AI.findings: ①ML预测误差与协变量系统相关，高精度模型仍可能扭曲系数；②标准验证无法检测此类偏差；③去偏方法可利用少量随机专家编码标签纠正偏差；④构建了三类ML任务分类法，明确了去偏方法的适用条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了ML在经济学史中系统性偏差的机制，并提供了去偏方法的理论框架与适用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学史研究者提供了数字化、模型选择、可重复性及偏差校正的最佳实践指南。

title: From Access to Capability: How Digital Public Infrastructure Converts into Financial Inclusion across Indian States and Union Territories
affiliations: Indian Council of Social Science Research

detail.title: From Access to Capability: How Digital Public Infrastructure Converts into Financial Inclusion across Indian States and Union Territories
detail.abstract: India's digital public infrastructure (DPI) has made formal financial access nearly universal, yet access and the welfare outcomes inclusion should deliver have diverged across its states. Treating DPI as a government information infrastructure whose public value is realized only downstream of access, we ask when access converts into capability and resilience, and which conditions decide. Drawing on Sen's capability approach and its concept of conversion factors, we develop the Access-Use-Capability-Resilience (AUCR) framework and operationalise it as a transparent, reproducible state-level composite index for India's states and union territories (28 states and 8 union territories; 34 in the analytical sample), built entirely from open official data. The index is robust across three weighting schemes (Spearman ρ = 0.89-0.94) and predicts welfare outcomes it does not contain-state income and household consumption-even after the poverty-linked component is removed. Pairing fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) with necessary condition analysis (NCA) on 34 jurisdictions shows that access is a statistically significant necessary floor (NCA d = 0.48, p = 0.03) but enters no sufficient configuration, whereas the combination of active use and a human-development base is sufficient for high capability (consistency 0.89; conservative and parsimonious solutions coincide; robust across twelve specifications and on the 28 states alone). The absence of use-especially access without useforms a conversion trap that captures even high human-development states such as Kerala. The findings reframe DPI policy from an access agenda to a conversion agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Sen的能力方法，构建了"接入-使用-能力-韧性"(AUCR)框架，通过对印度34个司法管辖区的fsQCA和NCA分析发现：数字公共基础设施的接入是必要但不充分条件，只有将接入转化为积极使用并结合人力发展基础，才能实现福利提升；"接入而不使用"构成转换陷阱，即使高人力发展地区也可能陷入其中。
AI.research_question: 当数字公共基础设施（DPI）使金融接入近乎普及时，接入何时能转化为能力和韧性？哪些条件决定了这一转化过程？
AI.motivation: 印度DPI虽实现了近乎普遍的金融接入，但各邦在福利成果上却出现分化，说明接入本身并不自动带来福利改善。现有研究缺乏解释这一"接入-福利"转化差异的理论框架和实证工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: Sen的能力方法及其"转化因素"概念；政府信息基础设施的公共价值实现理论。
AI.method: 构建AUCR国家层面的复合指数（基于公开官方数据，覆盖28个邦和8个中央直辖区）；采用模糊集定性比较分析(fsQCA)和必要条件分析(NCA)；三种权重方案进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）接入是统计显著的必要条件但不进入任何充分配置；（2）积极使用与人力发展基础的组合是高能力的充分条件（一致性0.89）；（3）"接入而不使用"构成转换陷阱，即使高人力发展地区（如喀拉拉邦）也会陷入。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AUCR框架，将Sen的能力方法操作化为可复制的国家层面复合指数；揭示了"接入-使用-福利"的转化机制，区分了必要条件与充分条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DPI政策提供了从"接入议程"转向"转化议程"的政策启示，强调促进积极使用和人力发展基础建设而非仅仅扩大接入。

title: Representational Divergence: A Method for Measuring the Gap Between Assertion and Realization in Contested Domains
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Representational Divergence: A Method for Measuring the Gap Between Assertion and Realization in Contested Domains

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a named inventor on eleven United States provisional patent applications filed May through June 2026 concerning cognitive-mapping and topological monitoring technologies (USPTO App. Nos. 64/074,530, 64/074,608, 64/074,779, 64/075,396, 64/079,009, 64/081,935, 64/084,355, 64/086,036, 64/089,881, 64/089,883, and 64/091,453), and a pending trademark application for NELE (Serial No. 99848342). Those applications are unrelated to the measurement method presented here, which stands independently. The author declares no other financial or personal conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a formal measurement method and a pre-registered confirmatory design. It involves no human participants, no patient data, and no primary data collection. The method's coding protocol incorporates a consultation pathway with descendant or living communities where a coding touches their presence, consistent with the CARE principles for Indigenous data governance, but no such consultation data are reported in this methodological article.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no specific funding for this research. All work was performed on personal infrastructure without institutional resources.

detail.abstract: I take up a situation that recurs across the humanities and social sciences: one party asserts the state of a contested domain while an independent source documents what that domain was, and we lack a general, reproducible way to measure the gap between the two without sliding into treating the gap itself as proof of motive. I define that gap as a formal object, representational divergence, and I use the term in a specific sense, distinct from its looser appearances elsewhere. Given an assertion surface and an independently constructed realization surface, registered over a shared domain and time index and coerced to a common comparison space, representational divergence is their signed, directional difference, reported not as a raw quantity but as the excess over a pre-specified baseline of non-motivated processes (error, inaccessibility, recording effort). I demonstrate the construct across three domains that share nothing but the logic of the object itself: colonial cartography, public-health service coverage, and corporate financial reporting. I state the method's defining property as a formal limit: excess divergence is necessary but never sufficient evidence of intent, which has to be established from an evidence stream independent of the measure. To show the instrument fixed end to end, I rehearse a pre-registered confirmatory application to Dutch colonial cartography of the Darien, 1609 to 1714, in which the instrument, baseline, inference plan, and falsification conditions are locked before any data are seen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“表征分歧”（representational divergence）这一正式概念，用于测量一方声称状态与独立来源记录状态之间的系统性差距，并区分其与动机证据的关系，在殖民制图、公共卫生服务覆盖和企业财务报告三个领域进行验证。
AI.research_question: 如何在不将差距本身当作动机证据的前提下，以可重复的通用方式测量争议领域的主张与独立记录之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 人文社科中反复出现一种情境：一方声称某领域的状况，独立来源却记录了实际状况，但缺乏通用的、可重复的方法来衡量这一差距，且容易滑向将差距本身当作动机（如欺骗、偏见）的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 表征分歧（representational divergence）框架：给定主张表面（assertion surface）与独立构建的现实表面（realization surface），在共享领域和时间索引上配准并强制到共同比较空间后，二者的符号化有向差异，并扣除非动机过程（误差、不可及性、记录成本）的基线后的超额部分。
AI.method: 提出表征分歧的正式定义和操作化方法；在三个领域（殖民制图、公共卫生服务覆盖、企业财务报告）进行示范性应用；并实施一项预注册的验证性研究（1609-1714年荷兰殖民制图），在研究开始前锁定工具、基线、推断计划和证伪条件。
AI.findings: 表征分歧可以作为一种形式工具跨领域使用；超额分歧（excess divergence）是意图的必要但不充分证据，必须依靠独立于测量本身的证据流来建立意图；预注册应用验证了该方法的端到端可操作性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“表征分歧”这一通用形式对象，为测量主张与现实差距提供了严格的、可重复的方法论；明确了超额分歧与意图之间的逻辑关系（必要但不充分条件），避免方法论上的循环论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同学科中处理声称与实际之间差距的问题（如历史档案评估、政策覆盖率监测、财务报告真实性检验）提供了可操作的分析工具；预注册设计增强了研究的透明度和可复制性。

title: Adapting the Black-Litterman Framework to Fixed-Income Portfolios

detail.title: Adapting the Black-Litterman Framework to Fixed-Income Portfolios

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no relevant financial or non-financial conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Classical mean-variance optimisation underpins portfolio construction but faces challenges in fixed income, where returns deviate from normality and input estimates are unstable. Many managers default to benchmarks or equal weighting to avoid estimation risk. The Black-Litterman framework offers an alternative by combining market-implied returns with investor views in a Bayesian update. 

This dissertation develops a fixed-income Black-Litterman framework that translates macroeconomic views into return expectations, calibrates view confidence, and imposes long only, fully invested portfolios. Using monthly data for five fixed-income asset classes from 2000 to 2025, three risk regimes (aggressive, moderate, conservative) are evaluated. Two BL variants are tested: BL , which retains the prior covariance, and BL (BL), which uses the posterior covariance, and both are compared with historical mean variance optimisation, the strategic benchmark, and an equally weighted 1/N portfolio.

Back-tests on rolling 60-month windows with one-month out-of-sample holds show that BL improves mean returns and delivers the strongest risk-adjusted performance among the BL variants in the moderate and conservative regimes, although it does not consistently beat the benchmark or 1/N. BL (_BL) achieves the highest return in the aggressive regime, but at the cost of higher volatility and trading intensity. The 1/N portfolio remains a strong baseline, with relatively high Sharpe ratios, shallow drawdowns, and very low turnover (~0.5% per month with monthly rebalancing). Overall, BL can be tailored to fixed income, but careful calibration of priors, risk aversion, and view confidence is essential, and simple diversification remains a formidable benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个固定收益版的Black-Litterman模型，将宏观经济观点转化为收益预期，并在2000-2025年间五种固定收益资产类别上进行回测。研究发现，BL模型在中等和保守风险区间能改善风险调整后收益，但简单等权重组合（1/N）仍然是强有力的基准。
AI.research_question: 如何在固定收益资产类别中有效应用Black-Litterman框架，并将其与传统的均值-方差优化、策略性基准和等权重组合进行比较？
AI.motivation: 经典均值-方差优化在固定收益领域面临收益非正态性和输入估计不稳定的挑战，许多管理者直接采用基准或等权重来规避估计风险。Black-Litterman框架通过贝叶斯更新结合市场隐含收益与投资者观点，提供了一种替代方案，但该框架在固定收益领域的适用性尚缺乏系统验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: Black-Litterman模型（贝叶斯更新框架），均值-方差优化理论，固定收益资产定价理论。
AI.method: 使用2000-2025年月度数据，涵盖五种固定收益资产类别，设定三种风险区间（激进、中等、保守）。测试两种BL变体（保留先验协方差的BL和采用后验协方差的BL_BL），并与历史均值-方差优化、策略性基准和等权重1/N组合比较。采用滚动60个月窗口、1个月持有期外样本回测。
AI.findings: （1）BL在中等和保守风险区间改善了均值收益并取得了最强的风险调整后表现，但未能持续战胜基准或1/N组合。（2）BL_BL在激进区间实现最高收益，但以更高波动率和交易强度为代价。（3）1/N组合仍然是强基准，具有较高的夏普比率、较浅的回撤和极低的换手率（月再平衡约0.5%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Black-Litterman框架系统性地扩展至固定收益领域，验证了先验协方差与后验协方差两种BL变体在不同风险区间下的表现差异，揭示了贝叶斯更新在固定收益组合构建中的适用条件和局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为固定收益投资者提供了一套可操作的BL模型校准指南（包括先验设定、风险厌恶系数和观点置信度的调参），同时警示简单分散化（1/N）策略的竞争力不容忽视，提醒实践者不要过度复杂化组合构建。

title: Zero-Sum Seas: Nodal Monopoly, Cartographic Secrecy, and the Recurring Grammar of State-Directed Maritime Control, 1415 to 1920
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Zero-Sum Seas: Nodal Monopoly, Cartographic Secrecy, and the Recurring Grammar of State-Directed Maritime Control, 1415 to 1920

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationship that has influenced or could be perceived to have influenced this research. The article is independent historical scholarship and is unconnected to the author's other professional activities.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human participants, animal subjects, or personal data; it draws on published scholarship and the documentary record.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This article argues that state-directed maritime commercial monopoly constitutes a recurrent but not continuous institutional form: each of the four systems examined here, the Portuguese feitoria network (1415 to 1580), the Spanish Casa de Contratacion and Carrera de Indias (1503 to 1778), the Dutch chartered companies (1602 to c. 1800), and the American Jones Act regime (1920 to the present), represents a rupture from its predecessor and a reinvention of the same underlying logic rather than a linear institutional inheritance. The unifying logic is mercantilist and strictly zero-sum: state power is measured by bullion accumulation, wealth gained by one political entity is wealth denied to all others, and the control of maritime nodes, routes, and spatial knowledge is the primary instrument of accumulation. Drawing on institutional history, the historiographical framework developed by William J. Novak for understanding the infrastructural American state, and the cartographic theory of J.B. Harley, the article demonstrates that each system achieved commercial dominance through three coordinated mechanisms: nodal capture (the physical or legal control of chokepoint ports and straits), route secrecy (the institutional suppression of navigational and hydrographic knowledge), and the public-private hybrid (the formal delegation of state commercial power to licensed monopoly entities that preserved the legal fiction of private enterprise while executing state strategy). The rupture-andreinvention thesis distinguishes this analysis from continuity arguments: what passes between systems is not institutions but a structural logic that political actors in each period discovered independently under conditions of intensified zero-sum competition. This article establishes the institutional and conceptual framework for these claims and identifies the empirical spatial evaluation that this framework makes testable across the cartographic archives of all four systems.

AI.tldr: 本文论证国家主导的海上商业垄断是一种反复出现但非连续的制度形式——葡萄牙、西班牙、荷兰和美国的四个垄断体系并非线性继承，而是各自在零和竞争条件下独立重新发明了相同的重商主义逻辑，通过节点控制、航线保密和公私混合三种机制实现商业霸权。
AI.research_question: 国家主导的海上商业垄断制度是连续继承的，还是在不同历史时期独立重新发明的？
AI.motivation: 既有研究倾向于将不同时期的海上垄断制度视为线性继承关系，本文试图提出"断裂与再发明"论，挑战连续性假设，解释为何不同时期、不同国家的垄断制度呈现出相似的结构逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重商主义与零和博弈理论；William J. Novak的基础设施国家史学框架；J.B. Harley的制图学/地图权力理论。
AI.method: 制度史比较分析，结合历史制图学档案分析，建立可检验的空间评估框架。
AI.findings: 四个垄断体系（葡萄牙feitoria网络1415-1580、西班牙Casa de Contratacion 1503-1778、荷兰特许公司1602-1800、美国《琼斯法案》1920至今）均通过三种机制实现商业主导：节点控制（咽喉港口与海峡）、航线保密（压制导航知识传播）、公私混合体（国家权力委托给特许垄断实体）。体系之间是断裂而非继承，共享的是结构性逻辑而非制度实体。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"断裂与再发明"分析框架，挑战制度连续性叙事；将基础设施国家理论、批判制图学与制度史结合，构建跨时空的比较分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代海洋治理、贸易保护主义（如《琼斯法案》）和海洋地缘竞争提供历史制度分析基础；建立了一套可检验的空间分析方法，可应用于四套体系的历史制图档案。

title: Structural Performance and Exposure to Research-integrity Risks in the University Systems of the Arab States: A Multilevel Morphological Characterization with SIR and IRIS 2026
affiliations: ,  and Prisma Global Cía

detail.title: Structural Performance and Exposure to Research-integrity Risks in the University Systems of the Arab States: A Multilevel Morphological Characterization with SIR and IRIS 2026

keywords: university systems of the Arab States

detail.abstract: The comparison of university systems relies on instruments that describe research performance and research integrity separately, yet the reach of the frameworks that articulate both dimensions beyond their region of origin remains little explored. This study applies to the university systems of the Arab States a multilevel morphological characterization framework that organizes the description of a system into four successive levels of resolution: distributed structural performance, distributed exposure to risk, the internal concentration of that exposure, and the composition of its components. Each level adds detail to the previous one without replacing it. Performance is measured through the HES Index derived from the SCImago Institutions Rankings 2026, and risk through a synthetic measure derived from the IRIS 2026 integrity indicators over the relevant exposure block. The universe comprises the ten Arab States systems with at least nine higher education institutions registered in SIR 2026. The results show that system size, structural performance, and exposure to risk are not ordered along a single gradient. Systems of similar performance can occupy opposite positions of exposure, so that the plane is read as a morphological field rather than as a scale. The fourth level reveals a heterogeneous composition of drivers, led by Hyperauthored Output, within which Discontinued Journals Output retains an appreciable differentiating weight and connects, as in the previous Latin American study, with the pattern of the systems of greater relative exposure. The stability of the positions was assessed through bootstrap resampling with 5,000 replicates, which confirms the main archetypes of the plane and shows that uncertainty increases significantly in the systems closest to the legibility threshold. The study identifies Bahrain as the threshold system of the analyzed universe and suggests that the frontier of bibliometric visibility and the transferability of the framework can be examined beyond the region that originated it.

AI.tldr: 本研究将多层级形态表征框架从拉丁美洲移植到阿拉伯国家大学系统，通过HES指数（绩效）和IRIS完整性指标（风险）的四层次分析，发现系统规模、结构性绩效与风险暴露并非沿单一梯度排列，且绩效相近的系统风险暴露可能截然相反；第四层次揭示了以超量产出为主导的异质驱动因素，停刊期刊产出在相对高暴露系统中具有显著区分权重，并通过5000次自助重采样验证了主要原型的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 该多层级形态表征框架能否超越其发源地（拉丁美洲）应用于阿拉伯国家大学系统？阿拉伯国家大学系统的研究绩效与研究完整性之间存在怎样的形态关系？
AI.motivation: 现有大学系统比较工具分别描述研究绩效和研究完整性，缺乏将两者结合并检验跨区域适用性的统一框架，因此需要探索该框架向阿拉伯地区的迁移可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层级形态表征框架：四个逐层细化的分辨率层级——分布式结构绩效、分布式风险暴露、风险内部集中度、风险成分构成。绩效基于SIR 2026的HES指数，风险基于IRIS 2026完整性指标的综合度量。
AI.method: 对SIR 2026中至少拥有9所高校的10个阿拉伯国家系统进行四层级形态分析；使用HES指数衡量绩效，IRIS指标合成风险度量；采用bootstrap重抽样（5000次）评估位置稳定性。
AI.findings: （1）系统规模、结构性绩效与风险暴露不沿单一梯度排列，绩效相近的系统风险暴露可能截然相反；（2）第四层次揭示了以超量产出（Hyperauthored Output）为主导的异质驱动因素，停刊期刊产出（Discontinued Journals Output）具有显著区分权重，并与拉丁美洲研究一致地关联于相对高暴露系统；（3）巴林成为分析宇宙中的阈值系统；（4）bootstrap验证了平面主要原型的稳定性，接近可读性阈值的系统不确定性显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多层级形态表征框架在阿拉伯地区大学系统的适用性，证明了该框架的跨区域迁移潜力；揭示了绩效与风险暴露的非线性、非单一梯度关系，丰富了大学系统比较的形态学视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿拉伯国家大学系统提供了同时衡量研究绩效与完整性的诊断工具，识别出巴林作为阈值系统的政策重要性，提示图书馆与文献计量能见度边界对框架可迁移性的影响。

title: Cervical Cancer Mortality in HPV Vaccine-Eligible Birth Cohorts in Argentina, 2005–2024: An Ecological Time-Series Study
affiliations: GESICA Foundation, Argentine Ministry of Health, Argentine Ministry of Health, Argentine Ministry of Health and Argentine Ministry of Health

detail.title: Cervical Cancer Mortality in HPV Vaccine-Eligible Birth Cohorts in Argentina, 2005–2024: An Ecological Time-Series Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Background: HPV vaccination prevents infection with oncogenic HPV types and high-grade cervical lesions, but population-level evidence from Latin America on invasive cervical cancer and mortality remains scarce. Argentina introduced HPV vaccination in 2011 for 11-year-old girls born in 2000 or later. We assessed early mortality and cytology patterns in birth cohorts potentially eligible for vaccination.

Methods: We did an ecological time-series study using national vital statistics for deaths from cervical cancer (ICD-10 C53) among women aged 20–69 years in Argentina from 2005 to 2024, with official annual female population denominators. Women aged 20–24 years in 2024 were defined as the index group. We compared 2024 with 2005–2018 using Poisson models and log woman-years as offset. As a complementary precursor outcome, we analysed HSIL or worse among evaluable cervical cytology samples from the public health-care network of Buenos Aires city in 2019–2025.

Findings: We analysed 19 080 cervical cancer deaths and 259 538 948 woman-years. Among women aged 20–24 years, mortality decreased from 0·44 per 100 000 woman-years in 2005–2018 to 0·23 in 2024 (rate ratio 0·51, 95% CI 0·19–1·40; p=0·19). In women aged 25–69 years, mortality increased from 7·99 to 10·14 per 100 000 woman-years (1·27, 1·20–1·34; p<0·0001). In Buenos Aires city, HSIL or worse decreased in women aged 20–24 years from 0·93% in 2019–2022 to 0·46% in 2023–2025, but increased in women aged 25–64 years from 2·24% to 2·64%.

Interpretation: Mortality and cytology data showed divergent patterns in birth cohorts potentially eligible for HPV vaccination at the target age. Although ecological and still early, these findings are consistent with an emerging cohort signal and support continued population-level monitoring of HPV vaccination impact in Argentina.

AI.tldr: 阿根廷自2011年将HPV疫苗纳入11岁女孩（2000年后出生）免疫规划后，在2024年观察到20-24岁年轻女性宫颈癌死亡率下降（0.44降至0.23/10万）及HSIL+细胞学异常率降低（0.93%降至0.46%），但25-69岁女性死亡率反而上升（7.99升至10.14/10万），提示HPV疫苗在目标接种队列中可能已出现早期保护信号。
AI.research_question: 阿根廷引入HPV疫苗接种后，潜在接种队列（2000年后出生女性）的宫颈癌死亡率及高级别细胞学异常率是否出现下降？
AI.motivation: 拉丁美洲地区缺乏基于人群的HPV疫苗对宫颈癌发病率和死亡率影响的实证证据，特别是阿根廷自2011年启动疫苗接种计划十余年后，亟需早期效果评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于HPV疫苗预防高危型HPV感染及宫颈癌前病变的生物学机制，以及疫苗接种覆盖人群队列效应理论，假设目标接种年龄队列（11岁女孩）成年后宫颈癌相关指标会下降。
AI.method: 生态时间序列研究，使用2005-2024年阿根廷国家生命统计宫颈癌死亡数据及布宜诺斯艾利斯市2019-2025年宫颈细胞学筛查数据，以20-24岁女性（2024年时）为指标组，采用泊松回归模型（以log女性-人年数为偏移量）比较2024年与2005-2018年死亡率。
AI.theory_contributions: 为HPV疫苗预防宫颈癌的队列效应提供了拉丁美洲地区首个基于人群死亡率的早期生态学证据，验证了疫苗在真实世界中对浸润性宫颈癌死亡率的潜在保护作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿根廷及其他拉丁美洲国家持续监测HPV疫苗长期效果提供实证依据，支持扩大疫苗接种覆盖率和维持免疫规划的政治承诺；同时警示需关注非接种队列（年龄较大女性）的疾病负担变化。

title: Diabetes Care Coverage under Chile's Explicit Health Guarantees, 2011–2023: A Municipal Latent-Class Analysis of Glycaemic Control and Retinopathy Screening
affiliations: University College London, Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Valparaíso, University College London, University College London - Institute for Global Health, University College London, Government of the United Kingdom - Moorfields Eye Hospital and University of Oxford - Nuffield Department of Primary Care Health Sciences

detail.title: Diabetes Care Coverage under Chile's Explicit Health Guarantees, 2011–2023: A Municipal Latent-Class Analysis of Glycaemic Control and Retinopathy Screening

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by the Chilean National Agency for Research and Development (ANID). ANW is supported by the Wellcome Trust (224390/Z/21/Z). This work was carried out with support from the NIHR Biomedical Research Centre based at Moorfields Eye Hospital NHS Foundation Trust and UCL Institute of Ophthalmology. University College London supported the presentation of preliminary results at the Association for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology 2025 Annual Meeting (Salt Lake City, UT, USA).

detail.abstract:
Background: Diabetes care depends on distinct clinical processes, yet glycaemic control and diabetic retinopathy screening are usually monitored together or only at the national level, which can hide local divergence within decentralised health systems. We examined whether municipalities in Chile, a decentralised system operating under the Explicit Health Guarantees (GES/AUGE) reform, follow distinct local trajectories of two programme-based indicators, and whether these trajectories track socioeconomic position.

Methods: In this retrospective longitudinal analysis we used annual municipality-level data from Chile's National Cardiovascular Health Programme for 2011–2023 (299 municipalities). We modelled effective glycaemic-control coverage (EGCC; the proportion of monitored patients with HbA1c <7% [<53 mmol/mol]) and diabetic retinopathy screening coverage (DRSC) separately with latent class mixed models selected from 140 candidate specifications, cross-classified municipal class membership, and examined membership by deprivation, urbanicity, and geographical zone. Reporting followed STROBE.

Findings: We identified four trajectories for each outcome. 272 of 299 municipalities (91·0%) followed glycaemic-control trajectories that stayed below 50% coverage throughout, far short of the 80% national target. DRSC trajectories were more heterogeneous. Glycaemic-control and screening memberships overlapped only weakly (Cramér's V 0·106; p=0·34), indicating statistically independent local processes. Trajectory membership showed no clear gradient by deprivation, urbanicity, or geographical zone.

Interpretation: Chile has made diabetes care broadly equitable across municipalities without making it adequate. Because glycaemic control and retinopathy screening behave as independent local processes, composite indicators obscure which process is failing where, and monitoring systems should track chronic-disease management and complication screening separately.

AI.tldr: 本文利用智利299个城市2011-2023年的纵向数据，发现血糖控制和糖尿病视网膜病变筛查在城市层面呈现独立的局部轨迹，二者关联极弱，且轨迹与 deprivation、城乡、地理区域无显著梯度关系。智利的糖尿病护理在地区间实现了公平，但整体质量不足。
AI.research_question: 在分散化的医疗体系（智利）中，各城市在血糖控制和糖尿病视网膜病变筛查这两项项目指标上是否遵循不同的局部轨迹？这些轨迹是否与社会经济地位相关？
AI.motivation: 糖尿病护理依赖于不同的临床过程，但血糖控制和视网膜病变筛查通常被合并监测或仅在国家级层面监测，这可能会掩盖分散化卫生系统内部的局部差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分散化卫生系统、项目指标局部轨迹、公平性（equity）与充分性（adequacy）区分、潜在类别混合模型
AI.method: 回顾性纵向分析，使用智利国家心血管健康计划2011-2023年299个城市的年度数据，分别对有效血糖控制覆盖率（EGCC）和糖尿病视网膜病变筛查覆盖率（DRSC）进行潜在类别混合模型分析（从140个候选规格中筛选），交叉分类城市类别成员，并检验成员身份与剥夺程度、城乡、地理区域的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 每个指标识别出4条轨迹。2. 91%的城市（272/299）在整个期间血糖控制覆盖率低于50%，远低于80%的国家目标。3. 糖网筛查轨迹异质性更大。4. 血糖控制和筛查的类别成员重叠极弱（Cramér's V=0.106, p=0.34），表明二者是统计独立的局部过程。5. 轨迹成员与剥夺、城乡、地理区域无显著梯度关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示在分散化卫生系统中，同一慢性病管理的不同临床环节（血糖控制 vs. 并发症筛查）在地方层面是独立运行的，不能以复合指标替代。2. 区分了"公平性"（地区间无差异）与"充分性"（整体水平不足）两个概念，表明公平可伴生不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为分散化卫生系统（如智利GES/AUGE改革）的监测体系提出改进建议：应将慢性病管理和并发症筛查分开追踪，而非合并监测。2. 提示政策制定者：即便实现了地区间公平，仍需关注绝对水平的充分性，避免因"公平掩盖不足"而忽视整体质量缺陷。

title: Market Segmentation and Return Drivers of Indian Infrastructure Investment Trusts and REITs

detail.title: Market Segmentation and Return Drivers of Indian Infrastructure Investment Trusts and REITs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether Indian Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) and REITs behave as part of the global infrastructure asset class or as a segmented domestic market, and what drives their returns. Using daily data from 2020 to 2026 across seven category portfolios spanning Indian and global infrastructure assets, we estimate GJR-GARCH and DCC-GARCH models and apply the Diebold-Yilmaz spillover framework. The total spillover index of 21.95% sits well below the 58.9% benchmark for developed REIT markets; foreign shocks explain only 2.47% of Indian InvIT variance at a 10-day horizon. Multi-factor regressions reveal a three-tier explanatory structure: adjusted R 2 reaches 67.9% for infrastructure stocks, 6.2% for REITs, and 2.5% for InvITs. The demeaned 10-year yield and Amihud illiquidity measure are the most relevant domestic state variables for InvIT pricing. These findings characterise Indian listed infrastructure as an early-stage segment shaped by idiosyncratic and liquidity risks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度基础设施投资信托（InvITs）和REITs是否属于全球基础设施资产类别，还是表现为分割的国内市场。使用2020-2026年日度数据，通过GJR-GARCH、DCC-GARCH和Diebold-Yilmaz溢出框架分析发现：总溢出指数仅21.95%（远低于发达市场58.9%），外国冲击仅解释InvIT方差的2.47%。多因子回归显示三级解释结构（基础设施股票67.9%、REITs 6.2%、InvITs 2.5%），去均值10年期收益率和Amihud非流动性是InvIT定价最相关的国内状态变量。结论：印度上市基础设施是受特质风险和流动性风险驱动的早期阶段细分市场。
AI.research_question: 印度基础设施投资信托（InvITs）和REITs是作为全球基础设施资产类别的一部分运作，还是作为一个分割的国内市场？其回报的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着印度InvIT和REIT市场的快速发展，投资者和政策制定者需要了解这些新型资产是否融入全球基础设施资产类别，还是呈现本土化特征，以及其回报的核心驱动因素，以便进行资产配置和风险管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场分割理论、全球资产类别整合理论、溢出效应理论、流动性定价理论
AI.method: 采用2020-2026年日度数据，涵盖七个类别组合（印度及全球基础设施资产）。使用GJR-GARCH模型（捕捉杠杆效应）、DCC-GARCH模型（动态条件相关性）以及Diebold-Yilmaz溢出框架（测度跨市场风险传递）。同时进行多因子回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）总溢出指数21.95%，远低于发达REIT市场58.9%的基准水平；（2）外国冲击仅解释印度InvIT方差的2.47%（10天预测期）；（3）多因子回归显示三级解释结构：基础设施股票调整R²为67.9%，REITs为6.2%，InvITs仅为2.5%；（4）去均值10年期国债收益率和Amihud非流动性指标是InvIT定价最相关的国内状态变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了印度InvIT/REIT市场的高度分割性，挑战了基础设施资产全球化整合的假设；揭示了新兴市场基础设施资产定价的特殊机制（特质风险与流动性风险主导）；为市场分割理论在新型资产类别中的适用性提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球投资者提供印度基础设施资产的分散化投资价值评估依据（低关联性意味着良好的分散化效果）；为印度监管机构理解本土资本市场发展阶段的特征提供参考；提示InvITs作为早期阶段资产面临较高的特质风险和流动性风险，投资者需纳入本地因子进行定价。

The author declares no financial interest in any outcome of this article and no personal or institutional relationship that influenced the study.

detail.abstract: Repeated directed human movement along fixed corridors produces measurable diffusion effects in knowledge, biology, language, environment, and material culture that no individual participant observes and no single source records. This paper proposes a framework, a methodology, and a set of computational instruments for recovering those effects, and it advances a specific, falsifiable claim for others to test: that the directed topological structure of a historical movement network predicts its observed spatiotemporal diffusion better than geographic proximity, undirected network distance, or directed shortest-path distance, and that circuit-structured systems are separable from convergence-structured systems by a measurable spectral signature. The proposal models historical human movement networks as time-evolving directed simplicial complexes and characterizes them with two distinct operators: directed path homology for topology and a directed, non-reversible diffusion generator for dynamics; the paper specifies why the two cannot be the same operator. It introduces a dual-layer evidence model that separates what the network structurally transmitted, recoverable from topology, from what the traveler's narrative reports, recoverable from text, and formalizes the gap between the layers as a directed Hausdorff distance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套框架、方法和计算工具，用于从历史人类移动网络（有向时变单纯复形）中恢复未被个体观察或单一来源记录的扩散效应，并论证有向拓扑结构比地理邻近性、无向网络距离等更能预测时空扩散模式。
AI.research_question: 历史人类移动网络的拓扑结构能否预测其观察到的时空扩散模式？有向路径同调与有向非可逆扩散生成算子之间有何关系？
AI.motivation: 重复性的定向人类移动（如沿固定走廊）会产生可测量的扩散效应，但这些效应未被任何个体观察到，也未被任何单一来源记录，现有方法无法恢复这些效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有向路径同调（拓扑学）、有向非可逆扩散生成算子（动力学）、双层次证据模型、有向Hausdorff距离
AI.method: 将历史人类移动网络建模为时变有向单纯复形，使用两个不同算子（有向路径同调与有向非可逆扩散生成算子）分别表征拓扑与动力学，并引入双层次证据模型分离结构传输与叙事报告。
AI.findings: 有向拓扑结构比地理邻近性、无向网络距离或有向最短路径距离更能预测扩散；环路结构系统与汇聚结构系统可通过可测量的谱特征区分；两个算子不能相同。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出有向路径同调与有向扩散生成算子不可互换的数学论证；提出分离网络结构传输与叙事报告的双层次模型及有向Hausdorff距离形式化。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了计算工具用于恢复历史扩散效应，提出可证伪的假设供后续实证检验。
